variety.label: Scientific Neo-Latin
variety.policyNoteEnglish: Classical morphology supports early-modern scientific reading. Explicit finite stem tables teach four conjugations, six persons and present active, imperfect active, perfect active and present passive. No runtime conjugator. Macrons mark pedagogical vowel quantity rather than historical typography.

review.noteEnglish: Scientific Neo-Latin teaching content, authored and self-reviewed by AI. Qualified Latinist review is pending; the schema status names a linguistic review requirement, not a claim that Latin has native speakers. Macrons are pedagogical vowel-quantity marks, not a diplomatic transcription of Newton. No independent or audio approval is claimed.

license.noteEnglish: Caatuu project owner approved AGPL-3.0-only and distribution on 2026-10-04. See docs/CURRICULUM_LICENSE_APPROVAL_20261004.json. Language and pronunciation reviews remain pending.
